title: Margin by product code
objective: Look up cost and price by code and calculate margin in KES and as a decimal share of the price.
instructions: For each product code in A2:A6, use XLOOKUP and the product list G1:J6 to return the cost in B2:B6 and the selling price in C2:C6. Fix the list ranges with $ signs. In D2:D6 work out margin in KES (price minus cost). In E2:E6 work out margin as a share of the price (margin divided by price). Leave E as a decimal, for example 0.52.
hints: Two XLOOKUPs per line: one for the cost and one for the price. Both use the code in column A as the key.
The code column in the list is G2:G6, the cost column is I2:I6 and the price column is J2:J6. Use $ signs on these ranges.
Margin in KES is the price minus the cost: C2-B2.
Margin percentage uses the margin divided by the price: D2/C2. Do not divide by the cost, that would be the mark-up.
